name: Speculative NFT community ritual
description: The greeting, encouragement, appraisal, and disclaimer repertoire of the 2021–2022 speculative NFT community expansion.
cause_of_death: Ownership criticism and subsequent speculative-collection collapse displaced the universal-success narrative; several expressions persist in narrower communities.

sources.title: GM, WAGMI, GN: Decrypt Ultimate Guide to Bitcoin and NFT Slang
sources.note: Inspected contemporary glossary with explicit meanings and usage examples; it notes that some vocabulary predates the NFT moment.

sources.title: Jack Dorsey says VCs really own Web3
sources.note: Inspected contemporary account of Web3 ownership criticism; directly attests right-clicker mentality and disputes booster claims.

sources.title: My first impressions of web3
sources.note: Inspected contemporary technical critique; attests NFT drop and analyzes centralized infrastructure beneath decentralization claims.

sources.title: The vast majority of NFTs are now worthless, new report shows
sources.note: Reports post-2021 collapse in speculative NFT collections. This is era-level displacement evidence, not a measurement of each phrase frequency.

entries.gloss: Collective encouragement expressing confidence that all participants will succeed.

examples.text: WAGMI; thank you for carrying the review to completion.

entries.rationale: The May 2022 Decrypt glossary directly attests the surface and community meaning. Contemporary criticism in 2021–2022 and the reported 2023 NFT market collapse bound the speculative community moment. Dates estimate salience in that moment, not first use or total disappearance; no per-phrase frequency series has been established.

examples.text: My right-clicker mentality prevents me from endorsing this proposal.

entries.rationale: The December 2021 Verge account directly attests the expression as a response to NFT skeptics. The 2023 reported NFT collapse bounds the booster moment; onset, peak and fade are estimated, with no claim that skepticism or the expression became extinct.
